# =============================================================================
# local-smart worker configuration  (Phase 3)
#
# Single source of truth for the Local Smart Worker. Mirrors config/local-fast.yaml
# in structure so one loader (scripts/lf_config.py) serves both.
#
# Parser note: stdlib YAML-subset only - scalars, simple lists, simple nested maps.
# No anchors, no multi-line strings, no inline maps.
#
# STATUS: quant / context / presets are the PROVISIONAL Phase 3 defaults. They are
# confirmed or revised against benchmarks/local-smart-results.md at the end of Phase 3.
# =============================================================================

model: local-smart

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- model source
source:
  logical_name: local-smart
  upstream_repo: Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B
  upstream_revision: c202236235762e1c871ad0ccb60c8ee5ba337b9a
  gguf_repo: unsloth/Qwen3.5-9B-GGUF
  gguf_revision: 3885219b6810b007914f3a7950a8d1b469d598a5
  license: apache-2.0
  parameters: 9B
  architecture: qwen35
  family: qwen3.5
  modalities: text
  note: upstream is a VLM; mmproj is intentionally not deployed for this text-only worker

# Selected quantisation. See benchmarks/local-smart-results.md for the evidence.
quant: Q4_K_M
model_path: D:\MultiAgent\models\llm\Qwen3.5-9B-Q4_K_M.gguf
model_sha256: 03b74727a860a56338e042c4420bb3f04b2fec5734175f4cb9fa853daf52b7e8
model_size_mb: 5417

alternates:
  Q5_K_M: D:\MultiAgent\models\llm\Qwen3.5-9B-Q5_K_M.gguf
  Q6_K: D:\MultiAgent\models\llm\Qwen3.5-9B-Q6_K.gguf

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- runtime
runtime:
  host: 127.0.0.1
  port: 8112
  # 16384 is the Phase 3 target. The KV geometry of the 9B is IDENTICAL to the 4B
  # (8 full-attention layers x 4 KV heads x 256 width), so context costs the same
  # 32,768 B/token and 16K is affordable.
  context: 16384
  parallel: 1
  threads: 12
  threads_batch: 12
  gpu_layers: 99
  batch_size: 2048
  ubatch_size: 512
  flash_attn: auto
  cache_type_k: f16
  cache_type_v: f16
  enable_thinking: false
  api_key_env: ""
  # Higher than the fast worker: the 9B is ~5.3 GB of weights alone.
  min_free_vram_mb: 6500
  expected_vram_mb: 6400

paths:
  llama_dir: D:\MultiAgent\tools\llama.cpp\b11254-cuda13.4
  server_exe: D:\MultiAgent\tools\llama.cpp\b11254-cuda13.4\llama-server.exe
  logs_dir: D:\MultiAgent\logs
  pid_file: D:\MultiAgent\logs\local-smart.pid
  stdout_log: D:\MultiAgent\logs\local-smart.stdout.log
  stderr_log: D:\MultiAgent\logs\local-smart.stderr.log
  health_url: http://127.0.0.1:8112/health
  models_url: http://127.0.0.1:8112/v1/models

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- sampling presets
presets:
  deterministic:
    temperature: 0.0
    top_p: 1.0
    top_k: 20
    min_p: 0.0
    repeat_penalty: 1.05
    seed: 20260401
    enable_thinking: false
  general:
    temperature: 0.3
    top_p: 0.9
    top_k: 40
    min_p: 0.05

    repeat_penalty: 1.0

## 3. Send to local-smart (9B)

Measured: 74.6 tok/s, 0.39 s TTFT at 16K, VRAM 5527 MiB at 16K, 100 % over 344 steps in a
6-minute stability run.

- multi-file code reading where the answer depends on how files interact
- traceback root-cause analysis rather than triage
- larger context compression (12–16K project history into a handoff)
- drafting a handoff another agent will resume from
- first-pass code review on a diff
- second opinion on a local result before escalating
